# moodle-student-mcp

> Moodle MCP server for students. A Model Context Protocol MCP server that gives AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor read only access to Moodle courses: assignments, due dates, grades, announcements and course content. Free, open source, read only. It cannot submit, edit or delete anything.

## Setup
- Needs MOODLE_BASE_URL and MOODLE_TOKEN.
- Copy the Moodle mobile web service key from Preferences, User account, Security keys.
- If a tool reports Not signed in, Access denied or Web services not enabled, the message says what to change.
- Run with npx -y moodle-student-mcp. Run `npx moodle-student-mcp doctor` to check the setup.

## Tools (all read only)

Every tool is listed below with its parameters and one example call. Example calls are JSON in the MCP tools/call shape: the tool name plus its arguments.

### get_my_courses
Lists your current courses with the ID other tools take as course_id. Hides finished and hidden courses.
Parameters: none.
Example call: `{"name":"get_my_courses","arguments":{}}`

### get_upcoming_due_dates
Lists up to 50 items due in the next 60 days across your courses that still need action, soonest first, with the course name and due date. Plain course events such as 'Course starts' and 'Course ends' are left out because there is nothing to do about them.
Parameters: course_ids (optional, array of course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the list, string or number items; leave it out to cover all current courses).
Example call: `{"name":"get_upcoming_due_dates","arguments":{"course_ids":[11]}}`

### get_overdue
Lists past due items from the last 45 days that still need action, with the course name and the date each was due.
Parameters: course_ids (optional, array of course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the list, string or number items; leave it out to cover all current courses).
Example call: `{"name":"get_overdue","arguments":{"course_ids":[11]}}`

### get_todo
One digest for what to do next across your courses: overdue work, work due soon, assignments with no due date, and the latest announcement subjects, each with the course name and due date. Submission status comes from the assignment list and the calendar adds quizzes and other activities. Announcements are the latest subjects from the last 7 days.
Parameters: course_ids (optional, array of course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the digest, string or number items; leave it out to cover all current courses), days_ahead (optional, how many days ahead to look, default 14), overdue_days (optional, how many days back to include overdue work, default 14).
Example call: `{"name":"get_todo","arguments":{"course_ids":[11],"days_ahead":14,"overdue_days":14}}`

### get_assignments
Lists up to 25 assignments for one course with due dates and submission status: not submitted, draft, submitted or graded.
Parameters: course_id (required, Moodle course ID from get_my_courses, string or number).
Example call: `{"name":"get_assignments","arguments":{"course_id":11}}`

### get_missing_work
Lists the assignments in your courses that you have not handed in yet, with the course name and the due date. Drafts that were never handed in are included, and work that was already handed in or graded is left out. Up to 25 assignments in each course are checked and the list holds up to 50 items.
Parameters: course_ids (optional, array of course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the list, string or number items; leave it out to cover all current courses).
Example call: `{"name":"get_missing_work","arguments":{}}`

### get_my_grades
Shows the posted overall grade for every current course, or "no grade posted yet".
Parameters: none.
Example call: `{"name":"get_my_grades","arguments":{}}`

### get_course_grade_items
Lists every graded item for one course with the mark and percentage, including the course total when there is one.
Parameters: course_id (required, Moodle course ID from get_my_courses, string or number).
Example call: `{"name":"get_course_grade_items","arguments":{"course_id":11}}`

### get_course_content
Lists the sections of one course, such as weeks or topics, with up to 40 activities in each, such as pages, quizzes and forums. Each activity shows its intro text when there is one, such as assignment instructions, label text or a page summary. Each file shows its name and a link with your key removed, ready for get_file.
Parameters: course_id (required, Moodle course ID from get_my_courses, string or number).
Example call: `{"name":"get_course_content","arguments":{"course_id":11}}`

### get_course_page
Reads the Page activities of one course, the pages listed as page in get_course_content, and returns their text with the HTML removed. Up to 5 pages are shown, each up to 20000 characters. Images and embedded media are not shown.
Parameters: course_id (required, Moodle course ID from get_my_courses, string or number), page_name (optional, part of the page title to pick one page; leave it out to read the first pages).
Example call: `{"name":"get_course_page","arguments":{"course_id":11,"page_name":"Week 1"}}`

### get_file
Downloads one course file resource, such as a PDF, slide deck or handout, from its file_url. Plain text and HTML files come back as readable text. A PDF with readable text comes back as text, and a PDF with no extractable text comes back with its file name, a link with your key removed and a note to open it in Moodle. Any other file type is not supported and comes back with its file name, a link with your key removed and a note that only plain text, HTML and PDF are supported, with a note to open it in Moodle. Only a link on your school's Moodle site is downloaded, so your key is never sent to another server. A link that points somewhere else is refused.
Files over 25 MB are not downloaded; the answer gives their name and link instead.
Parameters: file_url (required, URL of the course file to download, string).
Example call: `{"name":"get_file","arguments":{"file_url":"https://moodle.example.edu/webservice/pluginfile.php/1/mod_resource/content/0/slides.pdf"}}`

### get_announcements
Lists the latest news forum posts with subject, course name and text, up to 5 posts from each of up to 10 news forums. A course or forum the school server will not open is left out and the rest still shows.
Parameters: course_ids (optional, array of course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the search, string or number items; leave it out to cover all current courses).
Example call: `{"name":"get_announcements","arguments":{"course_ids":[11]}}`
